details: Seven loop-140 Au Pair review jobs failed after three broker-rejected rounds because exact SHA-256 evidence was required but no hashing tool was exposed.
Later Au Pair jobs succeeded, separating the capability-contract defect from provider or model health.
A loop-140-shaped two-file inspection returns independently derived SHA-256, byte, newline, and kind metadata with zero spawned commands and no content disclosure.
A manifest fixture returns only three declared RFC 6901 pointer outcomes and does not expose an undeclared sibling.
Every sorted test file completed with zero failures under bun run test:ci outside the restricted localhost-listen sandbox.

known_limitations: The candidate is not integrated, installed, deployed, or active in a live loop.
Automatic shell-command classification is unchanged; these tools are available to admitted unprofiled inspection and utility-audit jobs, while exact execution profiles remain single-tool.
